integrity: The complete-bipartite value four supplies a lower bound because every restrained Italian function on a crown remains feasible after restoring the deleted matching. At weight four, zeros must occur on both sides, forcing side weights two and two; each zero on one side then forces the matched coordinate on the other side to be zero. Hence the two label vectors coincide and have side weight two, which gives the exact classification and count.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats balanced crown graphs and minimum restrained Italian functions only.
The boundary graph Cr_3 has the same scalar value but a smaller minimum-function family.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from three through six and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown-graph treatment may exist.
title: Minimum restrained Italian functions of crown graphs
